ability.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
ability.description: Proficient with club, crossbow (light or heavy), dagger, handaxe, javelin, kama, nunchaku, quarterstaff, sai, shuriken, siangham, and sling. Not proficient with armor or shields.

ability.name: AC Bonus
ability.description: Add Wis bonus to AC when unarmored and unencumbered. Bonus increases by +1 at 5th level and every 5 levels after.

ability.name: Flurry of Blows
ability.description: Make one extra attack per round at highest BAB with a -2 penalty to all attacks. Penalty decreases at higher levels.

ability.name: Unarmed Strike
ability.description: Deal lethal or nonlethal unarmed damage as a Medium creature (1d6 at 1st, increasing with level). Treated as armed when unarmed.

ability.name: Bonus Feat
ability.description: Select a bonus feat from the monk bonus feat list at 1st, 2nd, and 6th level.

ability.name: Evasion
ability.description: On a successful Reflex save against an area attack, takes no damage instead of half.

ability.name: Fast Movement
ability.description: +10 ft. land speed when not wearing armor. Increases with level.

ability.name: Still Mind
ability.description: +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

ability.name: Ki Strike
ability.description: Unarmed attacks are treated as magic weapons for overcoming damage reduction. At 10th lawful, at 16th adamantine.

ability.name: Slow Fall
ability.description: Take damage as if a fall were shorter than it actually is, with distance reduced increasing with level.

ability.name: Purity of Body
ability.description: Immune to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases.

ability.name: Wholeness of Body
ability.description: Can heal own wounds, restoring up to twice monk level in HP per day.

ability.name: Improved Evasion
ability.description: On a failed Reflex save against an area attack, takes half damage instead of full; no damage on success.

ability.name: Diamond Body
ability.description: Immune to all poisons.

ability.name: Abundant Step
ability.description: Can use dimension door as a spell-like ability once per day, using monk level as caster level.

ability.name: Diamond Soul
ability.description: Gain spell resistance equal to monk level + 10.

ability.name: Quivering Palm
ability.description: Once per week, set up vibrations that can kill a living creature within 1 day (Fort save DC 10 + level/2 + Wis modifier).

ability.name: Timeless Body
ability.description: No longer takes ability score penalties for aging.

ability.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
ability.description: Can speak with any living creature, as though using a tongues spell.

ability.name: Empty Body
ability.description: Can become ethereal for 1 round per monk level per day, as the etherealness spell.

ability.name: Perfect Self
ability.description: Type changes to outsider. Gain damage reduction 10/magic.
